name: 9mm Girls: The Visual Novel
source:
You're the new rookie in town and you're already dealing with a heavy case.

Multiple people are missing in the dark megalopolis of Skyline City. It seems that the supernatural and corruption are intimately connected to your investigation.

No time for coffee and donuts, the clock is ticking and you have strange individuals to question, shady places to explore and a life changing decision to take!

[From [url=https://solikoseis.itch.io/9mmgirls]itch.io[/url]]

Based on the webcomic 9mm Girls.
translation:
你是初来乍到的菜鸟警员，却已经接手了一桩棘手案件。

阴暗的大都市天际城发生了多起失踪案，超自然现象与腐败势力似乎都与你的调查紧密相连。

没空喝咖啡、吃甜甜圈了，时间正在流逝！你得盘问古怪的人物，探查可疑的场所，还要作出一个改变人生的决定！

[摘自[url=https://solikoseis.itch.io/9mmgirls]Itch.io[/url]]

根据网络漫画《9mm Girls》改编。
